verdicts.reason: A keeps the 'Lumen & Fig' wordmark and fig mark dominant, but the circle is stretched into an oval and cropped at top, bottom and right, the wordmark straddles the oval's edge, and 'Skincare, slowly.' runs almost into the right canvas edge, so it can't ship. B has the hierarchy upside down: the tagline is larger than the shrunken brand name, the logo is jammed against the left edge and the fig mark sits on the oval's outline, and the circle is squashed into a wide ellipse, so the brand is lost.
